function.arguments: {"observation": "48 patients have duplicate `patient_id` entries, with each appearing exactly twice (sample_seq = 1 and 2). This means 96 rows are duplicates of 48 patients. The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient. Thus, we must deduplicate the data by keeping only the row with the maximum `sample_seq` per `patient_id`.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we will double-weight the 48 re-tested patients in any mean calculation, which introduces bias. We must deduplicate before computing any summary statistic by patient."}
function.name: note_finding
